symptomShortText: Customer assembly line jam due to OD taper exceeding 0.015mm cylindrical tolerance

defect.defectText: Outer diameter taper out of tolerance on CNC lathe

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-3310, Shift A - lathe operator executed tool wear offset per daily log sheet
EQ-LATHE02-003 chiller unit thermostat stuck closed, allowing coolant temperature to climb from 22C to 38.5C during afternoon continuous run
DOC-9104 Rev B - CNC in-process touch probing performed without thermal compensation offset algorithm
Alloy steel 42CrMo4 raw bar batch B-50388 dimensional runout and hardness 280 HBW verified compliant
CNC in-process optical touch probe GA-0450 calibrated at 20C; thermal expansion of stylus shank at 38.5C coolant caused false in-cycle offset calculation of +18um

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the bushing sleeve jam during customer automated press-fit?
fiveWhyChain.answer: The sleeve OD carried a taper of 0.028mm over its 60mm length, exceeding the 0.010mm drawing limit

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was the OD turned with a taper on the CNC lathe?
fiveWhyChain.answer: The in-process touch probe registered an incorrect baseline dimension and applied a false progressive tool compensation offset

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the in-process touch probe measure with an 18um error? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: Coolant temperature rose to 38.5C due to a failed chiller thermostat, thermally expanding the probe stylus while the calibration algorithm assumed constant 20C
fiveWhyChain.evidenceCitation: Metrology lab thermal expansion test report TR-2026-91

actions.actionText: Quarantine 120 sleeves at customer plant and sort finished inventory with air-gage OD micrometer
Replace faulty coolant chiller thermostat on WC-LATHE-02 and integrate thermal probe compensation macro in CNC program
Install automated coolant temperature interlock to halt machining if coolant exceeds 25C across all CNC lathe cells

fmeaLink.description: Dimensional drift caused by coolant thermal expansion of measuring probes

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Air-gage sorting quickly separated 18 bad sleeves from good stock at the customer dock
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: In-process probe macro lacked a temperature reference input to guard against coolant thermal buildup

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: Bushing Sleeve B45 machined on WC-LATHE-02 during afternoon shifts between 13:00 and 17:00
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: Morning shift parts on WC-LATHE-02 or parts machined on WC-LATHE-01 with functional chiller
isIsNot.notes: Thermal drift correlated directly with coolant sump temperature climb during prolonged run
